On its Q3 2023 call, PNC framed its 2024 expense plan around a goal to keep core expenses stable (excluding one-time charges) and highlighted two key initiatives: an expected $325 million in savings from a workforce reduction initiative that began in late 2023, and Continuous Improvement Program (CIP) savings targeted at a similar magnitude to the 2023 program.

U.S. Bancorp’s Q3 2023 call did not provide specific details on its 2024 expense plan or targets; it focused instead on achieving anticipated cost synergies from the Union Bank acquisition and prudently managing core expenses by identifying operational efficiencies across the business.
